scope: Smart color selection for the 46 existing SVG substyles. Prototype colors are design seeds, not final paint slots, usage statistics or a claim of accessibility/visual approval.

priority.manual: Bypass smart selection; preserve exact user input.
smart: Explicit current color intent within chosen style

projectReference.adaptation: Prefer whole alternate recipe; then bounded perceptual lightness/chroma changes inside the chosen semantic hue family. Never rotate every role independently.
projectReference.nearDuplicatePolicy: Do not evade exclusion with a one-channel increment. Perceptual separation is a soft ranking term, not a hard aesthetic rejection gate.
projectReference.explicitOverride: Only an explicit current user color request may override literal exclusion; record the override. Subject hue identity alone does not authorize copying an exact project value.

selection.primarySelection: Filter by style grammar and subject constraints. Rank complete compatible recipes with style/intent first; project harmony breaks comparable choices but must not determine a mean hue.
selection.stableTieBreak: Use configured recipe order, never per-icon randomness.
selection.projectFit: Equal-weight reference to overall intensity/temperature; compare complete recipe, not distance to project.primary.
selection.variantBehavior: Retry reuses the saved plan. Explicit recolor creates a new plan version. No background regeneration on theme/project edits.

boundedDerivation.description: Candidate refinement, not a new failure threshold.
boundedDerivation.fallback: If no readable candidate exists in the local range, derive another value in the permitted hue family or use another whole recipe; do not change object identity or reject the whole batch.

neutralFallback.rule: First readable candidate not copied from a project color; bounded neutral adjustment if all four collide. Never choose a saturated fallback.

batch.singleColor: One exact foreground per monochrome batch, shared by all subjects and both states.
batch.multicolor: Freeze recipe, named UI roles, gradients and repeated material paints; permit semantic per-object colors.
batch.statePair: Same colorPlanId and part color roles for outline/solid; state changes geometry, not hue.
batch.retry: Reuse batch and subject plans including object overrides; no re-selection for a failed item.
batch.legacy: Do not recolor successful old items. Derive a compatible plan from saved history for retries, or report unavailable evidence without fabricating continuity.
batch.concurrency: Resolve and persist a batch plan once before dispatch. UI responds immediately; no per-item color-planning model call.

backgrounds.unknownSurface: Provide separate light/dark variants or declare surface assumption; never promise universal contrast.
backgrounds.alpha: Evaluate composited paint against adjacent actual colors.
backgrounds.themeChange: Use saved paired theme paints for preview/export; changing UI theme does not regenerate icons or silently mutate saved SVG.

readability.scope: Necessary icon boundaries/features versus adjacent colors; not every decorative fill/highlight, not an automatic rejection score.
readability.unknownCriticalBoundary: Inspect real SVG at target sizes. Do not assume role token contrast proves rendered accessibility.
readability.response: Plan a readable role paint before generation; prefer local role-aware repair or warning over whole-batch model retries.

roles.ink: 识别轮廓/文字类前景（按风格需要）

recipeUsage: Select only the roles the style needs. Characteristic object colors are authored separately and recorded with stable partId/material keys; these recipes are not an exhaustive list of allowed output colors.

neutral-one-paint.rule: 一种前景色；所有主体、状态和重试共用；仅用户明确彩色要求才允许改为一个彩色前景。

doodle-ink.rule: 主体仅用中性深色自由手绘线；最多两处短小暖色笔触作为风格节奏，不描摹物品结构、不改变主体色。手动指定单色时不另加暖色。

duotone-outline.rule: 恰好两种实际颜色；从选定主体色相派生较深边界与较浅填充（不能盲用配方 ink 引入另一色相），透明开口保留。

duotone-flat.rule: 恰好两种不透明颜色；body 为较浅的主要体块，support 为较深的真实功能部件或局部结构。遵循参考图的浅大面、深局部关系，不把全部体块做成同等深色，也不凭空增加分面。

contrast-flat.rule: 恰好两个协调色相；一主一次，真实固有色优先，不切割物体凑双色。

alpha-two.rule: 一个基础色，两个透明度层级；在真实背景合成后检查识别部分。

alpha-three.rule: 一个基础色，最多三个结构强调层级；不造部件凑层数。

outline-alpha.rule: 同一基础色的实线与局部透明填充；填充不是第二个独立色相。

object-flat.rule: 按主体/材料/功能分配平涂色；可扩展真实语义颜色，不受配方角色总数限制。

pastel-one-hue.rule: 一个彩色色相的浅柔主体与适度加深边界；由候选配方派生同色系，不直接取其中异色角色。

pastel-two-hue.rule: 两个柔和彩色色相；需要边界时仅派生同色系较深层级，不再引入第三色相。

pastel-tile.rule: 仅此类允许整体柔彩底板；底板 support 为衬底，主体 ink 或语义配色独立解析，分别检查可见性。

gradient-two.rule: 两个预先配好的端点；全图共享方向和坐标范围，不能逐部件重启渐变。

gradient-radial.rule: 同一色系的较亮中心和较深外围，亮度跨度受控。

gradient-three.rule: 使用保存的完整三色渐变配方；中间色是独立设计的色相节点，不是两端的数学平均。保持顺序和连续过渡，不拆成色带或增加几何分面。

material-volume.rule: 先按材料/物体确定基色，再派生受光、背光；多个部件共享光照方向。

material-glass.rule: 透明主体加可读边缘；在实际背景合成后检查，不靠加不透明白底解决。

colored-hand.rule: 统一手绘线色与真实语义填色；边界/填充共享几何，不允许错版溢色。

colored-pixel.rule: 深色像素边线围住真实部件。柔彩色块数量由可见语义部件或真实结构分区决定；单一连续材质可只用一种主体柔彩，不得为消费色槽把它斜切成多色。第三色只在有真实小部件时点缀。边线负责对比，柔彩填充不按独立文字对比度强行变深。

neon-single.rule: 一个蓝青色系，分为照明角色而非物品配色：body 是承载轮廓对比度的细窄管壁，core 是明亮冰青灯芯，halo 是外围蓝青光晕。三层必须完全共用几何与中心线，不新增同心圈或物体部件。只有 body 承担浅底边界对比度，core/halo 不按普通单色图标统一压暗。不得把三者设成同一个深青色，也不添加纯白灯芯、渐变或偏移阴影。旧快照缺少 core 时复用原有 body/halo，不在重试时重选配色。

glow-single.rule: 一种薰衣草色系基色，低透明同色光晕；主体清晰，光晕不能代替轮廓。

neon-dual.rule: 蓝色至洋红色的连贯描边渐变；后方保留同方向、同几何的克制渐变光晕，上层核心清晰。不改成普通灰黑线或无光晕的普通渐变线。

深线浅面同色系；浅面可以较轻，但外轮廓和关键内线必须可读。
浅色主体搭配深色功能结构，对齐已确认参考图的面积层级；保持足够彩度和清晰轮廓，不靠添加描边补救。
不同于同色深浅；天然双色物品优先原本色系，其余选择完整主/陪衬组合。
优先中性两级，也可选一个批次强调色；不把透明层误识别为可自由择色的新部件。
按真实结构分配层级；低透明区域不能独自承担必要边界。
同一基础色，保留明显透明内部，不能变成全填充双色。
物品、材料、传统动作语义优先；不是默认四种品牌色。
统一的是跨图标角色、材料色和鲜艳程度；允许不同物体有不同固有色。

styles.renderingRule: 插画多彩使用纯色平涂与克制结构立体感，不使用光效。按实际材料保留固有基色，必要侧面、凹入面、后层可派生同色系较深纯色；每个区域内部颜色均匀、不透明。通过前后遮挡、连接根部和连贯弧形的结构边界表达厚度，主体正面保持宽大清楚；平涂不等于把所有部件合成同色剪影。语义 partColors 定义材料基色，允许结构配色派生，但不生成亮面/中间调/暗面光照色带。不添加渐变、高光、光晕、发光、模糊、投影或固定光向。重复圆润部件使用一致的前后层色彩角色与真实遮挡保持可区分，不随机逐颗换色。不要使用无关批次色、不任意对半切色，也不要为凑层次增加不存在的部件。用户明确锁定的精确色值仍优先。基础 object-flat 角色与历史已保存配色保持兼容。
styles.notes: 圆润明快的纯色卡通插画；用前后遮挡、必要的同色系深色侧面和独立分层色块表达平面结构立体感，不使用渐变、光照、高光、发光或投影。
只保留一个彩色色相；不是所有柔彩默认紫色，也不是中性灰。
两种柔和彩色有温差但不争抢；用明暗承担边界而非添加黑色粗框。
柔彩底板不是每种风格通用背景；如主体需真实颜色，可以使用语义配色。
继承现有冷色渐变描边契约；纯线风格，不能使用橙色实面或浅色中段。
一般两端色；对象需要强固有色时从其色系派生渐变，不添加部件只为展示渐变。
由选定基色生成同色系中心与边缘，非直接照抄任意两色线性渐变。
基于完整有序色带选三色，不随机挑三种品牌色。
宽而柔的明暗，低高光强度；不是所有物体涂奶油色。
更明确的局部反光，主体保持真实颜色；白高光不计为新的物品颜色。
前面、连接侧面同色系明暗，不把整个偏移副本当深色背面。
不同朝向表面的明暗由同一光照决定，不能逐面随机换色。
乳透面、扩散明暗和清晰边缘；不以灰雾覆盖主体。
面接近透明，边缘承担形状；避免不透明白面冒充玻璃。
蓝/薰衣草染色玻璃，不能被通用蓝灰中性规则压成纯色。
统一线色后按真实闭合区域配色；不使用阴影和渐变制造丰富度。
色块应帮助识别真实部件，颜色数量由必要结构决定。
青色是此风格的专用选择，不是智能配色全局默认。
主体色和光晕同色系；不得把彩色光晕中性化。
蓝到洋红的连续两色描边与克制同色光晕，保留发光风格身份。

generationPrompt: Choose colors after shape and part structure. Use SELECTED_STYLE_COLOR_GRAMMAR and the saved BATCH_COLOR_PLAN; project colors are equal-weight harmony references, never mandatory paint slots. Do not copy any of their literal visible paint values, privilege primary, or average their hues. An explicit user override must be recorded.
For generic UI symbols, use the saved exact color roles consistently. A monochrome batch and both State Pair members share one foreground.

For multicolor subjects, identify each meaningful material or conventional color feature. Preserve that identity; author a new compatible shade where needed and record the partId and reason. Do not recolor every object with the batch body paint.

Distribute color by real components and visual area: a dominant body, quieter supporting parts and an optional small accent. Do not split a surface, invent detail or add colors merely to fill all roles.
Respect the style's permitted hues, flat/gradient/opacity/material treatment. Check important edges against TARGET_SURFACE; highlights and mask paints have different roles.

Reuse the saved subject color plan on retry; never reselect palette or change the corresponding state's colors. Return the part color assignments in the existing designCard along with the SVG, without an extra model call.
Manual color mode bypasses these smart choices. A user-specified exact color override is recorded explicitly, not silently treated as a project-color suggestion.

acceptance.registry: Every existing style must have exactly one mapping and valid recipe/grammar references.
acceptance.visual: Prototype palette review, generated object diversity, actual 16/24/48px light/dark renders, batch/state/retry continuity. Not satisfied by config tests.
acceptance.activation: Integrated into the current generation pipeline after user authorization; full generated visual review remains pending.
acceptance.validation: node scripts/check-smart-color-selection-spec.cjs verifies shared configuration, runtime wiring and representative opaque seed contrast. Runtime tests are separate; neither proves generated SVG visual quality.

subjectIdentity.rule: Resolve colors for meaningful parts, not a whitelist of object names. Apply only color distinctions permitted by the selected style.
subjectIdentity.conflict: Color-limited styles preserve the most informative distinctions and use shape/negative space for the rest. Never silently add hues beyond the style contract.
subjectIdentity.status: Use red/yellow/green only for an actual error/warning/success meaning or explicit object color, not an arbitrary accent on every UI symbol. Shape must also express the status.

derivationRules.roleSeeds: Recipe values are seeds. Ink/support/companion are not all automatically used; a style-specific role resolver produces the final plan once.
derivationRules.sameHue: Duotone and mono-pastel derive all visible tonal roles from the selected body hue. Do not blindly use recipe.ink if it introduces another hue family.
derivationRules.twoHues: Contrast-flat uses body/companion or two identity-bearing subject hues; exactly two paints. Pastel-two-hue may derive tonal boundaries from those same two hues.
derivationRules.glass: Derive tint from glass body, readable rim from glass ink and restrained highlight. Alpha and rim definition differ by the selected glass substyle.
derivationRules.radial: Derive center/edge from one body hue rather than copy a two-hue linear ramp.
derivationRules.threeStops: Choose an ordered intermediate hue between the approved endpoints; render the actual SVG gradient because endpoint contrast alone does not prove the interior.
derivationRules.semanticExtension: Additional colors may only map to real subject/material/status parts in styles permitting multiple colors. Record them before the final subject plan is frozen.
derivationRules.paintExclusionScope: Exclude literal project hex values in visible paint tokens, including white highlights unless explicitly overridden. Structural mask black/white, alpha compositing and interpolated gradient pixels are not discrete chosen foreground paints.
derivationRules.colorArea: For flexible multicolor UI symbols, start with a 60–80% dominant area, 20–40% combined support, and optional 0–10% accent within that total. Structural truth overrides those advisory ranges; never invent geometry to meet them.
